title: A3 Load Balancing (Envoy, replicas A/B/C)
description: Assignment 3: per-replica HTTP and gRPC traffic through Envoy. All rate/quantile windows are [1m].

panels.title: HTTP request rate per replica (req/s, rate [1m])
panels.description: Requests handled per second by each replica, scraped directly from the replica (not through Envoy).

panels.title: HTTP share of total traffic per replica (%, rate [1m])
panels.description: Expected: A-only 100/0/0, round robin ~33 each, weighted 2:1:1 = 50/25/25.

panels.title: HTTP share now (%, rate [1m])
panels.description: Last value of the share query; compare with 33.3% (RR) or 50/25/25 (weighted).

panels.title: HTTP active requests per replica (gauge @5s scrape; avg in-flight [1m])
panels.description: 'now' = in-flight gauge sampled every 5 s. 'avg in-flight' = rate(duration_sum[1m]) = time-averaged concurrency (Little's law). The HTTP gauge counts all application paths except /health and /metrics.

panels.title: HTTP p50 / p95 latency per replica (server histogram, window [1m])
panels.description: Server-side handling time from the replica histogram; quantiles are interpolated within buckets.

panels.title: HTTP errors by status per replica (req/s, rate [1m])
panels.description: Non-success status_code values only. Requests that never reached a replica (Envoy 503) appear in the Envoy row, not here.
